properties.description:
Clark Distributing Co. is a plant-based food wholesaler headquartered in Hendersonville, Tennessee, serving retail grocery stores, health food stores, and foodservice operators across Tennessee, Georgia, Alabama, Kentucky, Ohio, Michigan, and Illinois.
We specialize in vegan and vegetarian products in both retail and foodservice sizes, with a growing focus on acai sorbet, one of the fastest-rising categories in plant-based food. Whether you're stocking shelves or building out a menu, we offer personalized service, competitive pricing, and the product knowledge to help your plant-based offerings grow.
We are currently expanding our reach across the Nashville corridor, metro Atlanta/North Georgia, and Huntsville, AL, and are always looking to build new partnerships with retailers and foodservice operators who share our passion for plant-based food.
Visit us at www.clarkdistributing.com or explore our online store at www.vegefood.com
